description: Generated placeholders that reference one another, so a resolver answer selects a template whose own resolution or expansion then fails. Nested.InnerFails has an outer placeholder over a TAGGED value selecting a template that names an inner placeholder over a RAW term, so only the inner one reaches the resolver and only it should be named by the contextualization -- and switching the tagged value to CONSONANT selects a template that names nothing, so the inner placeholder is never resolved at all and the same poisoned term never reaches the resolver. Nested.Cycle has the resolver's answer select a template that leads back to the placeholder that selected it, which is undetectable until interpolation and therefore produces the selection-annotated double contextualization at DefaultStrings.java:1356-1359. One locale, so the policy is never consulted.
